title: Foreclosure Postponement Allowance on Short Sales
content:
# Foreclosure postponement allowance — Payoff and Loan Satisfaction

On the payoff case of an Approved Short Sale Payoff requested by the borrower of record, the foreclosure postponement allowance enters the short-sale closing deductions. It follows the loan's maturity case under the Maturity and Due-and-Payable Cases product: its status and its referral date.

The foreclosure postponement allowance is USD 450.00, the full postponement fee, when the maturity case's status is referred to foreclosure and its referral date is at least 30 calendar days before the approval date; it is USD 250.00, the initial postponement fee, when its status is referred to foreclosure and it was referred fewer days before, a case with no referral date counting as referred 0 days before; a case in any other status carries nothing (0.00).

## Boundary table

| Maturity case on the approval date | Foreclosure postponement allowance |
|---|---|
| Referred to foreclosure, referral date 30 or more days before | USD 450.00 |
| Referred to foreclosure, referral date 29 days before | USD 250.00 |
| Referred to foreclosure on the approval date itself (0 days) | USD 250.00 |
| Referred to foreclosure, no referral date recorded | USD 250.00 |
| Due and payable, or in its extension period | nothing |

The 30-day mark is reached on the 30th calendar day after the referral date: a referral dated exactly 30 days before the approval date takes USD 450.00.
